articles.title: A Moon City for a Million People? Scientists Say the Water Would Run Out
articles.summary: Two scientists checked the numbers behind plans for a city on the Moon and found that power would be fine, but water would run out in about 100 years.

articles.title: Ukraine's Starlink Is Back at Full Speed After a Week of Limits
articles.summary: After more than a week of connection trouble, Ukraine's satellite internet is working at full speed again, and leaders on both sides are explaining what happened.

articles.title: She Always Thought She Was a Citizen. Now She Faces a Voting Charge
articles.summary: Marva Cook, 66, of Syracuse, New York, says she only recently learned she was not born in the United States, and she has now been charged with voting illegally.
